data.name: SHELF_PORT
data.purpose: The port the catalogue listens on.

data.name: SHELF_CATALOGUE_URL
data.purpose: The base URL of the catalogue that shelf reads.
data.effect: Every books command fails, because shelf has no catalogue to read.

data.name: SHELF_MIRROR_ACCOUNT
data.purpose: The account shelf uses at the catalogue mirror.

data.name: SHELF_MIRROR_TOKEN
data.purpose: The token that shelf sends to the catalogue's mirror.
data.effect: shelf reads the catalogue without its mirror.

data.name: SHELF_LOG_LEVEL
data.type: log-level: one of error, warn, info, debug
data.purpose: The least severe message that shelf writes to its log.

values.description: Failures, and anything that may become one.
Each command that runs, and what it changed.
Every step, for finding a fault.

data.name: SHELF_REGION
data.type: region: one of eu, us, ap
data.purpose: The region whose catalogue mirror shelf prefers.
data.check: The region must have a mirror that answers.

data.name: SHELF_OUTPUT_BUDGET
data.purpose: The most bytes that one run prints, which lowers the tool's own limit and never raises it.
data.effect: A value that is not a whole number of bytes from 1 up to the tool's limit leaves the limit as it is.

data.name: NO_COLOR
data.purpose: Turns colour off in the tool's output when it holds any value.
data.effect: Colour follows CLICOLOR_FORCE, CLICOLOR, TERM and whether the stream is a terminal.

data.name: CLICOLOR
data.purpose: Turns colour off in the tool's output when it is 0.

data.name: CLICOLOR_FORCE
data.purpose: Turns colour on in the tool's output, whatever the stream is, when it holds a value other than 0.

data.name: TERM
data.purpose: The kind of terminal the tool prints to; dumb turns colour off in the tool's output.
data.effect: Colour follows the other colour variables and the terminal.

data.name: SHELF_PROGRAM
data.purpose: The name of the program that runs the tool, such as flightdeck, which the tool records in its usage log.
data.effect: The usage log records no program name.

data.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
data.purpose: The directory that holds the tool's state, such as its usage log, under a directory named after the tool.
data.effect: The state directory is .local/state under the home directory.

data.name: TRACEPARENT
data.purpose: The W3C trace context of the caller, which the tool's usage log joins.
data.effect: The run starts a new trace.

data.name: TRACESTATE
data.purpose: The W3C trace state of the caller, which goes with TRACEPARENT.
data.effect: The run records no trace state.
